representation: World-space FEM nodes and rigid geometric-origin samples, orientation xyzw.
initial_velocity: All dynamic actors initially at rest.

bodies.name: sphere
bodies.representation_note: Recentered local mesh and state at exact compound COM; world geometry unchanged.

rules: Keep every physical shape, count, initial transform, physical material and controller.
Numerical discretization/internal steps may change; remap outputs to frozen vertices.
Articulations are finite-mass dynamics with bounded force/torque actuation, not prescribed motion.
No existing physics engine, stored answer trajectory or source simulator is provided.
contact_topology: The 13 rings are physically separate open-center nonconvex meshes, initially interlocked with each other, pivot eye, and integral sphere eye. Do not replace the chain by a massless hinge or a string.

contact_material_semantics.friction_selection: FEM: material.friction (source friction_mu). Rigid and plane: coup_friction. The legacy physics.friction is only a default, not a per-body override.
contact_material_semantics.restitution_note: Source Rigid.coup_restitution is zero; IPC uses dissipative barrier/friction contact, with no added restitution impulse.
contact_material_semantics.finite_rigid_floor_note: The plane flag concerns infinite planes only. A finite mesh/box floor is an ordinary rigid actor and uses the rigid-rigid flag.
